M1.S3.T3.C6#0.answer: Shape 1 has one line of symmetry, a slanted line through its tip. Shape 2 (kite) has one vertical line of symmetry. Shape 3 has none. Shape 4, the L-shape, has one diagonal line of symmetry through its corner. Shape 5 (scalene triangle) has none.

M1.S5.T5.C17#0.answer: Any correct drawing works. Example: (a) a semicircle (one line, perpendicular to the straight edge) or a shape with a round top and a symmetrical body; (b) an ellipse or a rectangle with rounded bumps at the top and bottom (vertical and horizontal lines); (c) a circle-bump flower of four equal round loops around a square (with 4 lines).

M3.S19.T19.C76#0.answer: a) Equilateral triangle: 3 lines, 3 angles, namely 120°, 240°, 360°. b) Isosceles triangle (not equilateral): 1 line, no rotational symmetry. c) Parallelogram that is not a rectangle or rhombus: no line, angles 180° and 360°. d) Isosceles trapezium: 1 line, no rotational symmetry.
